selector.rationale: Progressive neurological deficits, respiratory distress, and multiple bilateral symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions support ADEM, despite normal sensory function.

rejected.label: Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder

rejected.label: Multiple Sclerosis

rejected.label: Toxic Encephalopathy
rejected.why: While substance use is noted, the specific pattern of neurological deficits and imaging findings better supports an inflammatory process like ADEM
